		      ,FM.DIVISION_CODE                               AS divisionCode
		      ,FM.COMPANY_CODE                                AS companyCode

		      ,IM.HS_CODE                                     AS itemHsCode
		      ,FBD.REQ_QTY * SD.UNIT_EXCHANGE_RATE            AS requirementQty
		      ,FBD.FROM_DIVISION_CODE                         AS fromDivisionCode
		FROM   (SELECT SD.SALES_NO
		              ,SD.SALES_SEQ
		              ,SD.PRODUCT_CODE

		              ,SD.COMPANY_CODE

		              ,SD.BOM_YYYYMM

		              ,CAST(COALESCE(SD.ATTRIBUTE02, '1') AS DECIMAL) AS UNIT_EXCHANGE_RATE

		        INNER  JOIN SALES_MST SM
		        ON     SD.SALES_NO = SM.SALES_NO
		        AND    SD.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE
		        AND    SD.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE
		        WHERE  SD.SALES_NO = '1018116406FRT101202604'

		                )

		INNER  JOIN FCR_MST FM

		AND    SD.SALES_SEQ = FM.SALES_SEQ
		AND    SD.DIVISION_CODE = FM.DIVISION_CODE
		AND    SD.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE

		INNER  JOIN FTA_BOM_DTL FBD

		AND    FBD.YYYYMM = SD.BOM_YYYYMM

		INNER  JOIN ITEM_MST IM

		ON     PL.ITEM_CODE = V.ITEM_CODE
		AND    PL.COMPANY_CODE = 'FRT100'
		AND    PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN V.FROM_DATE AND V.TO_DATE
		LEFT   OUTER JOIN COO_DIVISION_V D
		ON     D.DIVISION_CODE = PL.DIVISION_CODE
		AND    D.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE

		       (SELECT 1
		        FROM   EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM
		        INNER  JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD
		        ON     ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO
		        AND    ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE
		        AND    ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE
		        AND    ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE
		        AND    ECD.FTA_CODE = V.FTA_CODE
		        AND    ECD.COO_YN = 'Y'
		        WHERE  ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4'
		        AND    ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE
		        AND    ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE
		        AND    ECM.DIVISION_CODE = CASE
		                   WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'F' THEN PL.DIVISION_CODE
		                   WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'D' AND ECM.APPLY_TYPE = 'A' THEN ECM.DIVISION_CODE
		                   WHEN ECM.DOCUMENT_TYPE = 'D' AND ECM.APPLY_TYPE = 'M' THEN D.COO_RECEIPT_DIVISION_CODE
		               END
		        AND    ((ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE)
		               OR (ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_NO = ECD.WAREHOUSING_NO
		                   AND PL.SEQ = ECD.WAREHOUSING_SEQ))
		        AND    ECD.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE)
